facts.text: The rcs/fr3 environment is registered with gymnasium as EmptyWorldFR3()
The FR3 environment controls the arm in Cartesian TQuat mode
The FR3 environment configures SimConfig with realtime=True, async_control=False, frequency=1 Hz and max_convergence_steps=500
When async_control is false, SimEnv.step_sim calls sim.step_until_convergence() instead of a fixed number of physics steps
The FR3 robot is named right (robot_prefix_template)
MultiRobotWrapper builds the action and observation spaces as dicts keyed by the robot name
The environment wraps each robot in RelativeActionSpace unless relative_to is RelativeTo.NONE
A relative Cartesian action defaults to at most 0.5 m of translation (DEFAULT_MAX_CART_MOV)
The relative TQuat action box bounds the three translation elements by +-max_cart_mov, the quaternion scalar by -1 and 1, and the three quaternion vector elements by -inf and inf
The gripper action box is one value from 0 (closed) to 1 (open)
TQuatDictType is a tquat field of 7 values bounded by [-0.855, -0.855, -1, -1, -inf, -inf, -inf] and [0.855, 0.855, 1.188, 1, inf, inf, inf]
JointsDictType bounds the joints array element-wise by the robot's joint limits
TRPYDictType is an xyzrpy field of 6 values bounded by [-0.855, -0.855, -1, -180, -180, -180] degrees and [0.855, 0.855, 1.188, 180, 180, 180] degrees
ArmObsType joins TQuatDictType, JointsDictType and TRPYDictType and adds tquat_flange
The gripper wrapper adds one normalized width to the observation
SimEnv.step advances the simulation and then returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info)
CoverWrapper.reset resets the simulator, seeds only the wrapper's np_random, then advances the simulator 30 steps to apply the reset state

determinism.notes: reset(seed) reseeds the fake's random generator (and cap.world.seed.v1 sets the seed of the next reset), so one seed and one action sequence repeat the same state hashes; the upstream environment homes the robot and seeds only the wrapper's np_random (base.py:315-317), and no upstream run was compared

gaps: the deployed fake is a kinematic stand-in: a relative Cartesian offset moves the pose and the gripper value is applied directly; no MuJoCo rigid-body, contact, actuator or sensor dynamics are run and no forces are modelled

the registered environment runs MuJoCo inside SimEnv.step_sim and settles each control transition with step_until_convergence; the clone states a 1 Hz control loop (configs.py:84) but no fixed physics timestep, so timestep_ms is 0 and ticks do not map to a fixed simulated interval
the camera observations of the registered environment (bird_eye and wrist, 1280x720 at 30 Hz) are NOT COVERED: the observation space of this package carries robot state only

the fake narrows the three quaternion vector action elements from the upstream's unlimited -inf and inf to -1 and 1 so every action bound can be exercised; the translation and quaternion scalar bounds follow base.py:70-79
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, so one cap.world.step tick is one control transition and not a fixed number of simulated seconds
no physical device is modelled; the fake was never compared with an upstream MuJoCo run because the gate never imports the clone
snapshot and restore are not offered: SimEnv exposes set_replay_state but no get_state/set_state pair

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime refuses step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, while the last observation stays readable
